title: Bloomsbury Publishing - What is Philosophy?
description: Confucius. Plato. Kant. Beauvoir. Sartre. Žižek. Do you know who they are and what they thought about the big questions in life? Across more than 2500 years these philosophers have questioned and expanded what we know. This accessible notebook offers an entry point into their ideas and influence. How to live a good life? What is real? Does freedom exist? Drawing exclusively on curated philosophy content published by Bloomsbury, this notebook is grounded in excellence and rigorous scholarship. Use it to ask your own questions and deepen your understanding of why philosophy matters.
